title: Paralegal - Conveyancing
description:
I am currently working with a well esteemed national Law Firm in Birmingham who has an immediate need for Paralegal - Conveyancing / Conveyancing Assistant for a project.

Job Title: Paralegal - ConveyancingLocation: BirminghamContract Type: 3 months (roughly)Salary: £16.32 per hour - £19.00 per hour via an umbrella company Working Pattern: Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home

Key Responsibilities of a Paralegal - Conveyancing
- Provide day-to-day support to solicitors and fee earners on a wide range of residential conveyancing matters, including sales, purchases, and Right to Buy transactions.
- Open new files, draft initial client care documents, and ensure compliance checks are completed.
- Assist in preparing and reviewing contracts, transfer deeds, completion statements, and other legal documents.
- Carry out searches, review results, and liaise with clients, local authorities, lenders, and other solicitors to progress matters smoothly.
- Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence, ensuring all communications are logged and dealt with promptly.
- Maintain accurate case records using the firm's case management system.
- Prepare files for exchange and completion, ensuring deadlines are met.
- Provide administrative support, including billing, file closing, and other ad-hoc tasks as required.

Essential Skills & Experience:
- Previous experience working in a paralegal or conveyancing assistant role, ideally within residential property.
- Ability to manage your own caseload with supervision while meeting strict deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain legal processes clearly to clients.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail when drafting and reviewing documentation.
- Strong IT skills, with experience using case management systems.
- A proactive, professional, and client-focused approach.
